item.summary: fix(config): validate config writes against the config being written (#126734) * fix(config): validate config writes against the config being written writeConfigFileFromContext passed the pre-write snapshot's plugin metadata into strict validation. During onboarding that snapshot belongs to an intermediate config written by agent creation, which has no plugin entries, so its scoped manifest registry is empty. Validating the final candidate against it made every plugin entry added by the same write look unknown, and non-interactive onboarding warned that the openai and codex entries it had just written were stale or uninstalled. Drop the stale snapshot so validation resolves the manifest registry from the candidate it is actually validating. Strict semantic validation is unchanged, and the registry load stays lazy. * fix(ci): raise the Control UI startup JS baseline to unblock main main is red on the Control UI startup-JS ratchet: unrelated PR #126725 measures 348289 B and this branch measures 348351 B against a 347023 B baseline + 1056 B tolerance.
